title: HDFC Diners Club Privilege credit card

cardOverview.overviewText: A lifestyle card within the Diners Club series providing accelerated points on dining, travel, and shopping, along with lounge access and milestone perks.

benefitRows.name: BookMyShow
benefitRows.description: Buy 1 Get 1 Free on Movie/ Non-movie Weekend Tickets
benefitRows.offer: Buy 1 Get 1 Free on movie and non-movie tickets via BookMyShow.|Applicable for Friday, Saturday, and Sunday shows, irrespective of booking day.|Maximum discount of ₹250 per ticket, up to 2 free tickets every calendar month.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this offer, visit the BookMyShow website or app.|Select your movie, date, time, and seats.|Proceed to payment and find the offers/discounts section.|Select the applicable bank discount offer and enter your card details.|Complete the payment to get the Offer.

benefitRows.name: Insurance
benefitRows.description: Accidental Air Death Cover, Hospitalization, Baggage Delay, Credit Liability Cover
benefitRows.offer: Coverage includes: ₹1 crore for accidental air death; upto ₹25 lakhs for emergency overseas hospitalization; upto ₹50,000 for baggage delay (capped at $10 per hour for 8 hours); and credit liability cover upto ₹9 lakh.
benefitRows.howToAvail: Contact at 1800-266-9777 or schedule a call. You can also send a missed call to +91-9980970424 or email buyonline@hdfclife.in.
